approval_decisions: Approve fixed rank/tie/missing-score/small-group rules and strength 0.5
Approve A/B/P comparison and single domain-separated permutation
Approve per-example mean loss and no-op audit; fresh matched A required
Approve unchanged full cohorts, sampler, initialization, seed, FP32 and EL-to-IM training
Approve frozen development-only metric plan and no tuning or sealed-test access

conditions.B: Original labels; within-HLA positive midrank weights
conditions.P: Original labels; B weights Fisher-Yates-permuted within-HLA positives

evaluation.inference: One seed, one permutation; exploratory descriptive contrasts only
evaluation.primary: IM average precision, grouped score ties; not trapezoidal PR area

fixed_training_reference.architecture: Unchanged authentic BigMHC; full EL checkpoint / four-tensor IM transfer overlay
fixed_training_reference.baseline_execution_evidence: Task2.10 user-approved summary; local Task2.10 checkpoints/logs not acquired or verified in this task
fixed_training_reference.optimizer: AdamW, preserve complete native/default parameter dictionary

loss.EL: mean(weight_i * BCEWithLogits(logit_i, original_label_i, reduction=none)); denominator=batch rows, not sum weights
loss.IM: Unmodified native mean BCEWithLogits; original IM labels only

permutation.algorithm: Sort positive immutable source_row_ids lexicographically, Fisher-Yates descending j with local randrange(j+1); pin Python version
permutation.identity_assignments: Permitted; no repeat draws or outcome-based choice
permutation.stream: SHA256(version + NUL + permutation + NUL + decimal_seed + NUL + exact_HLA), big-endian integer -> local random.Random

purpose: Preregister predictive utility only; aggregate design analysis; no training, label changes or row-weight export

rank.missing_or_unsupported: Abort matched experiment preflight; no substitution, population change or fuzzy HLA mapping
rank.population: All 70069 retained original EL positives, grouped by exact resolved HLA; observation-based, no deduplication
rank.small_n: Same rule including n=1 or all tied -> weight 1; flag n<10 descriptively; no exclusion
rank.ties: Exact Decimal numeric equality of stored nonnegative finite hour strings; no tolerance, jitter or tie breaking
